description.value: Jim's Pizza Walnut Grove is a locally run pizza restaurant in Langley's Walnut Grove neighbourhood, serving a broad menu of specialty and build-your-own pizzas alongside pasta, ribs, and chicken wings. The shop operates its own delivery fleet and also accepts online orders, making it a practical stop for a takeout meal. Gluten-free crust and vegetarian options are available on request.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 14m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone 604-888-4880, address #10 20349 88th Ave Langley, email). The site confirms pickup ordering ('For pick up or delivery call the store to order') and online ordering, and lists a gluten-free crust option ('Gluten free available in a medium size') and a vegetarian pasta option ('Make it Vegetarian, ask for your pasta to be made with marinara'). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant with an active website, confirmed contact details, and a clear menu. A practical food stop for touring cyclists in Walnut Grove.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free crust available in medium size (add-on noted on menu page); vegetarian pasta available on request ('Make it Vegetarian, ask for your pasta to be made with marinara')
